en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-belt.title: Cargo Belt
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-belt.description: Carries train cargo packages, and packs loose shapes or fluid into them as they arrive - so a train unloader or an ordinary belt can feed one directly. Connects to belts, pipes and train stations alike. Drag to lay a line.
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-belt-left.title: Cargo Belt Corner (Left)
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-belt-left.descri: Placed automatically when a dragged cargo belt turns.
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-belt-right.title: Cargo Belt Corner (Right)
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-belt-right.descr: Placed automatically when a dragged cargo belt turns.
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-store.title: Cargo Store
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-store.descriptio: Buffers up to 25 cargo packages on each of three layers, in three independent queues. Takes shape or fluid cargo - each layer keeps whichever kind reaches it first.
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-packager.title: Shape Cargo Packager
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-packager.descrip: Packs loose shapes into train cargo packages, the same packages a train station makes. Feed one shape type per layer.
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-unpackager.title: Shape Cargo Unpackager
en-US.cargo-tools.group.cargo-unpackager.descr: Empties shape cargo packages back onto an ordinary space belt, for feeding ordinary machinery. Train stations accept packages directly and do not need one.
en-US.cargo-tools.group.fluid-cargo-packager.d: Packs fluid from a space pipe into train cargo packages, the same packages a fluid train station makes. Feed one fluid per layer.
en-US.cargo-tools.group.fluid-cargo-unpackager: Empties fluid cargo packages back onto a space pipe. Fluid train stations accept packages directly and do not need one.
en-US.cargo-tools.toolbar.cargo.title: Train Cargo
en-US.cargo-tools.toolbar.cargo.description: Pack shapes or fluid into train cargo packages, carry them on cargo belts and buffer them outside a station. Stations accept packages directly.
